label: Scenario G — Multi-Tier Global Enterprise (Escalation)
description: Multi-tier global structure that requires human compliance review. Root: Delaware LLC. Parent: Cayman holding company. Above that, a Singapore Pte Ltd held in part through a nominee, a BVI holding company, and an irrevocable Swiss trust with foreign-national beneficiaries. Three jurisdictions, nominee arrangement, offshore intermediary, and an irrevocable trust + foreign nationals — the agent should call recommend_escalation.

CERTIFICATE OF FORMATION
MERIDIAN US HOLDINGS LLC
State of Delaware

FIRST: The name of the limited liability company is Meridian US Holdings LLC.
SECOND: The registered office is 1209 Orange Street, Wilmington, Delaware 19801, and the registered agent is The Corporation Trust Company.
Date of Formation: January 22, 2026.
Purpose: holding company for U.S. acquisitions in industrial automation and logistics infrastructure on behalf of the Meridian Global group.

MEMBERSHIP

The sole member of Meridian US Holdings LLC is Meridian Global Industries Ltd, an exempted company incorporated under the laws of the Cayman Islands (company number CR-388214), with its registered office at PO Box 309, Ugland House, Grand Cayman, KY1-1104, Cayman Islands.

Meridian Global Industries Ltd holds one hundred percent (100%) of the membership interests in Meridian US Holdings LLC. The full ownership chart above the Cayman parent is summarized in the accompanying Group Org Chart but is not exhaustive — additional intermediate entities and a Swiss trust structure exist.

MERIDIAN GLOBAL GROUP — SUMMARY OWNERSHIP CHART (PARTIAL)
Prepared by: Allen & Overy (London) — internal client use only

Tier 1 (US):  Meridian US Holdings LLC (Delaware) — 100% owned by:

                    └ owned by:
                       (a) Apex Pacific Pte Ltd (Singapore) — 60%
                       (b) Helvetia Family Trust (Switzerland, irrevocable) — 40%

NOTE: This chart shows only the most material ownership lines. Additional intermediate vehicles exist in Luxembourg and Jersey holding minority interests in operating subsidiaries; those subsidiaries are out of scope for the U.S. account-opening file.
NOTE: Apex Pacific Pte Ltd's register lists Crescent Nominees Pte Ltd as the shareholder of record for 50% of the issued shares. Crescent Nominees holds those shares for the benefit of Mr Lim Wei Jian under a declaration of trust dated 12 June 2021. The original declaration is held by Allen & Overy Singapore.

BVI INTERMEDIATE

The remaining 50% of Apex Pacific Pte Ltd is held directly by Hartwell Family Holdings (BVI) Ltd (BVI Business Companies Act, registration number 1882104), which is in turn 100% owned by Mr Oliver James Hartwell (UK national, resident in London).

TRUST DETAIL

Helvetia Family Trust is an irrevocable family trust established under Swiss law on 8 March 2018. Trustee: Banque Privée Geneve AG. Settlor: Mr Dieter Friedrich Müller. Named beneficiaries with fixed economic interests: Mr Dieter Friedrich Müller (50%) and Ms Anna Sophie Müller (50%). Both beneficiaries are Swiss nationals. The trust deed is held by Banque Privée Geneve AG; only an executive summary has been provided to the U.S. counterparty to date.
